request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; IOG contract noted as closing August 31, 2026.
deliverables: Integrate cardano-node and cardano-wallet releases and maintain Nix build infrastructure, dependency updates, security patches, and platform compatibility.
Provide Daedalus-compatible stable releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork and maintain Leios, Peras, and Nested Transactions readiness.
Maintain binary signing continuity through the IOG signing arrangement for official releases.
Maintain Windows, macOS x86_64, macOS aarch64, and Linux platform builds with full Japanese translation across new features.
Add Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support and support newer hardware wallet models as they emerge.
Implement a CIP-30 dApp connector in Daedalus with documentation and no external API dependency.
Provide ongoing user support through GitHub, community forums, and direct channels, including Japanese-language support.
Publish a Daedalus architecture assessment by Q3 2027.
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. administered through Intersect
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 as a time-and-materials engagement covering protocol maintenance, ecosystem expansion, user support, and related oversight.

claims.claim: Daedalus is presented as Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, deriving wallet and governance data directly from chain data without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
The proposal states that opt-in telemetry shows approximately 4,000 monthly active Daedalus users, with true usage asserted to be higher because privacy-conscious users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs says it has maintained Daedalus under an IOG contract since January 2026 and shipped Mithril snapshot bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The proposal says Se7en Labs has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The requested 1,785,333 ADA budget is allocated to 1,666,667 ADA for team labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The proposal states that any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.

Success metrics include releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork, cardano-node no more than 2 major versions behind the mainnet recommendation, 100% signed official releases, all four platform builds passing CI, Keystone and Flex support, CIP-30 support, Japanese support, and a public architecture assessment.
The proposal says release-timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain without relying on applicant self-reporting.
The proposal asserts that the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds, verify milestones, disburse monthly against verified work, hold funds in a dedicated auditable account, and use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with external oversight committee participation.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for Se7en Labs to maintain and improve Daedalus over 2026-2027, with major claimed public-good benefits around full-node wallet continuity, hard fork readiness, hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp access, Japanese localisation, support, and Intersect-administered milestone oversight.
